fusions.name: Recited Verse
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. Looses 3 spore pods in a spread, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spoken Contagion
fusions.desc: Hurls a spore word that deals 14 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Practiced Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Marginal Note
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
